examples: Install a skill and use it in your next session without copying files by hand.
Install a plugin that adds an MCP server: the sheet prints the exact command it will run, and you tick to allow it.
how_to: Press install on a card. The skill is added where your sessions can use it.

A plugin that declares an MCP server shows a boxed notice with the full command and the names of the environment variables it gets (never their values). The install button stays off until you tick the box.
name: Install from the catalog
summary: install a skill or plugin from the catalog straight into a session.
where: The install button on each skill card in the catalog.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
